name: com.helpfulmods/catalog
title: Helpful Mods Catalog
description: Find TypeScript source mods, read setup requirements, and prepare a cart for human checkout.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find TypeScript source mods for a feature you need, or find Foundation Kit when listed. This public lookup returns mod summaries with IDs and catalog prices, the total mod match count, separate kit matches when available, and pricing policy. Results are limited to a single page, with empty arrays for no matches. Use get_mod_details for a product's full record or get_setup_overview for prerequisites.

query.description: Keywords or a short description of the feature you need, such as "Stripe billing" or "team workspaces". Omit or leave blank to browse.

category.description: Filter by a catalog category. Use "application" to look for Foundation Kit. Omit to search all categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of standalone mod summaries to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 16. Foundation Kit matches are counted separately.

tools.name: prepare_cart_link
tools.description: Build a public cart link after the buyer has chosen products. Returns the link and the selected IDs, omitting standalone mods already included in the selected Foundation Kit. Unknown or duplicate IDs return an error. The buyer can review the cart before signing in and confirming the final total and payment at checkout.

items.description: Lowercase product ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel" or "foundation-kit" when listed.

productIds.description: Distinct listed product IDs from search_catalog. Include each ID once.

tools.name: get_mod_details
tools.description: Look up the full public catalog record for a standalone mod or Foundation Kit after finding its ID with search_catalog. Returns its price, published features and limits where supplied, and pricing policy. Unknown and hidden IDs return the same error. Use get_setup_overview for setup steps or get_compatibility_guidance to compare published mod support with your stack.

id.description: Lowercase product ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel" or "foundation-kit" when listed.

tools.name: get_setup_overview
tools.description: See what it takes to set up a standalone mod or Foundation Kit before you buy. Returns public requirements, setup steps, verification checks, and paths to relevant files inside the purchased package where applicable. Unknown and hidden IDs return the same error. Use get_mod_details for features and pricing.

id.description: Lowercase product ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel" or "foundation-kit" when listed.

tools.name: get_compatibility_guidance
tools.description: Review published support for up to eight standalone mods before choosing what to install. Returns the stack you supplied alongside each mod's supported features, limitations, and questions to check against your application. Confirm the fit in your own project. Unknown or hidden IDs return an error.

items.description: Lowercase standalone mod ID from search_catalog, such as "funnel".

ids.description: One to eight standalone mod IDs returned by search_catalog.

environment.description: Describe the application stack you plan to use, such as "Node.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Firebase Auth".
